rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for taking an oath or emphatically saying that something is true.

example.jyutping: ngo5 faat3 sai6 ngo5 mou5 gong2 daai6 waa6

rows.note: Use this when someone stubbornly insists that something is true despite disagreement or contrary evidence.

example.english: I swear I wasn't the one who spilled the drink.
example.traditional: 我死都話唔係我打瀉杯嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sei2 dou1 waa6 m4 hai6 ngo5 daa2 se3 bui1 je5

rows.note: Use this when someone uses offensive or obscene language rather than making an oath.

example.english: They swear all the time, making everyone uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢成日講粗口，搞到大家好尷尬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 cou1 hau2 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Use this formal legal verb when an official administers an oath to another person.

example.english: The judge has to swear in the witness before the testimony begins.
example.traditional: 法官要先監誓，證人至可以作供。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 jiu3 sin1 gaam1 sai6 zing3 jan4 zi3 ho2 ji5 zok3 gung1
